justification: Lines 0038 and 0046–0049 reject the claim that the direct-product construction generates every automorphism, matching the confirmed defect. Concretely, swapping vertices 1 and 2 preserves the path edges {0,1},{0,2}, but mixes blocks {0,1} and {2}. Every product in gamma_1, and every permutation generated from those products, preserves both blocks, so this automorphism is necessarily omitted.
